# superset_chart (Data Source)

Looks up a chart by its name, for example to place it on a dashboard or to send it with `superset_report`. Chart names are not unique in Superset: the lookup fails when no chart matches, or when several do.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_chart" "sales_by_day" {
  name = "Sales by day"
}

resource "superset_report" "weekly_sales" {
  name     = "Weekly sales"
  type     = "Report"
  crontab  = "0 9 * * 1"
  chart_id = data.superset_chart.sales_by_day.id
  recipients = [
    { type = "Email", target = "sales@example.com" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the chart. The comparison is exact.

### Optional

- `datasource_id` (Number) Identifier of the dataset of the chart. Set it when several charts share the name.

### Read-Only

- `datasource_type` (String) Type of the dataset of the chart, usually `table`.
- `description` (String) Description of the chart.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the chart.
- `url` (String) Path of the chart in Superset.
- `viz_type` (String) Visualization type of the chart, for example `echarts_timeseries_line`.
